# Accepted R package advisories, one id per line, with the reason above it.
# Every entry is explained in docs/SECURITY-AUDIT.md. All three packages ship
# inside the immcantation/suite base image; they are removed from this list
# when that base image is upgraded.

# gh (GitHub API client): arbitrary code execution through a crafted response.
# Never loaded by the services; present only as a dependency of usethis.
RSEC-2025-0

# plotly: prototype pollution in its JavaScript widget. Never loaded by the
# services; dependency of Seurat/enchantr. The services render no HTML widgets.
RSEC-2025-1

# png: buffer overflow when installed from source on Windows with R < 4.2.
# The images are Linux with R 4.4.3.
RSEC-2026-1
